HRTC to add 350 new buses and retire old JNURM fleet

State transport corporation HRTC announced that it will purchase 350 new buses for its fleet, while the existing JNURM (spelled JNNURM in another report) buses will be withdrawn. The board of directors is scheduled to approve the purchase at an upcoming meeting, with the decision reported from Shimla.
